theorem: The exact frozen frame ordering is reconstructed from the 45-octet syndrome hypergraph, transporting the canonical PSp(4,3) action to the complete Pass-1821 cover census. The transported action has order 25,920 and reproduces exactly 394,200 fixed-frame covers, 327 cover orbits, and 3,547,800 global covers. For every orbit representative, an exact least-supported-frame search proves that its disjointness link contains no eight mutually disjoint covers. Hence no nine exact covers partition the 540 frames, so the frame graph has no 9-coloring and chi(H)>=10.
